title: Taiwan Detects 4 PLA Aircraft Sorties, All 4 Crossing into Central/Southwestern ADIZ
detail: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 4 PLA aircraft sorties, 6 PLAN vessels and 3 official ships operating around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. (UTC+8) September 22, 2026; all 4 sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line, entering the central and southwestern ADIZ sectors. Taiwan's armed forces responded with CAP aircraft, navy ships and coastal missile systems. Sortie and vessel counts held at the low end of the post-Jioupeng-drill range for a second straight day, one day before Xi Jinping's arrival in Washington for a three-day state visit.

title: Taiwan Dailies: Washington Asks Taiwan Officials to Reduce US Visits Ahead of Trump-Xi Summit; US, China to Set Up AI Dialogue Mechanism
detail: Taiwan's major dailies reported September 22, 2026 that Washington had asked Taiwanese officials to reduce the frequency of visits to the United States in the run-up to President Trump's Washington summit with Xi Jinping, as the two governments finalized plans to establish a bilateral AI dialogue mechanism. The reports, part of a broader roundup on the summit's trade, AI and Taiwan agenda, reflected concern in Taipei that Taiwan's profile could be deliberately minimized to avoid complicating US-China negotiations just before Xi's September 23-25 visit — even as officials in Washington continued to describe support for Taiwan's self-defense as unchanged.
